note: Example 2 is an Albuquerque supply well binary mixture. Sample SSW_2007 contains a small young component and an older component constrained using 14C. Gas UZ=0 while 3H and 14C UZ=15 years. The latest saved fit assumes component-2 mean age 12100 years, DP 0.1 and equal DIC. Historical cached outputs need tolerance for original XLL discretization and must not be treated as unique solutions. Original examples do not supply the uncertainties needed by this application. The loaded 5% (minimum 0.05) uncertainty values are illustrative weighting scales; replace them before statistical interpretation. Only selected observations share the fitted model.
